notes: Profiles are annual log returns per state. The mandate's horizon governs; the ReturnSet is a property of the world, not of a household.

Basis: nominal. Inflation pass-through under the scenario Regime RGM-1af6968e287768c9 (depression: -4.00% a year): each instrument profile is its historical real return (nominal minus the historical per-state inflation of the currency it is measured in) plus beta * ln(1 + inflation), and a nominal bond also takes the price change -duration * (ln(1 + scenario inflation) - ln(1 + historical inflation)), a log return with no cap; beta per instrument and its source (house or override) in provenance.inflation_pass_through, calibration ipt@1.1.0. Role profiles follow the same rule with the weighted beta and bond duration of their blocks, from the historical USD inflation (per role in provenance.inflation_pass_through.roles); block profiles carry no pass-through.
Four of the 25 states are extrapolated beyond the hull of the five phase estimates, reproducing the published reference. They are labelled.

Instrument profiles: profile_method=forward_12m_smoothed in currency=CHF; the default estimator: the 12 month forward return after each month, measured per phase, read onto the 25 states by pchip and lightly smoothed across neighbouring states; computed on request.
Currency: instrument profiles measured in CHF, converted monthly at the point of use before estimation. Role profiles are the long annual record in USD and are not converted.

inflation_pass_through.source: House table, owner decision of 29.09.2026 ('inflation pass-through beta'): beta per instrument type, gold and precious metals 1.0, commodities 1.0, inflation-linked bonds 1.0, real estate 0.8, equities 0.6, cash 0.0 (owner, 29.09.2026: cash loses the full inflation, no duration), nominal bonds 0.0 plus a duration loss in log form, no cap (owner, 29.09.2026), hedge funds / alternatives 0.5, digital assets 0.5, volatility 0.5; durations (house assumption): aggregate bonds 6, government bonds 7, short-dated bonds 0.25. Register mapping by asset class, refined by name and price proxy (FMRE-34); confirmed by the owner on 29.09.2026: infrastructure as real estate, corporate, high yield and Asian credit duration 6, Private Debt short-dated. Role profiles take the weighted beta of their long-record blocks (owner, 29.09.2026; block types FMRE-40).
inflation_pass_through.formula: scenario nominal = (nominal - ln(1 + pi_hist(s))) + beta * ln(1 + pi_s) - D * (ln(1 + pi_s) - ln(1 + pi_hist(s))) for a nominal bond (a log return, no cap); scenario real = scenario nominal - ln(1 + pi_s); pi_hist(s) the historical per-state inflation of the currency the profile is measured in (USD for a role profile), pi_s the scenario Regime's inflation_final_12m; a role profile takes beta = sum(w_b * beta_b) and D = sum(w_b * D_b) over its blocks
